notes: Immunity bits verified against Bloons/*.json bloonProperties: Lead 1, Black 2, White 4, Zebra 6, DDT 3, Purple 8, Glass 64; Frozen 16 = the bit Sharp (17) adds over Shatter (1). Camo is not a damage bit: it is FilterInvisibleModel(isActive) targeting.
Attacks inside AbilityModel are not decoded; abilities are listed by name with damages/makesTowers flags.
A projectile can carry its own noCamo: an attack that sees camo whose projectile has FilterInvisible still cannot hit camo.
cannot/canDamageVia count direct damage, sub-projectiles and DoT; canDamageVia marks properties reached only via sub-projectiles (sub) or DoT.
Records hold attack keys; the attack bodies are in the top-level attacks table (identical attacks are shared).

schema.attack: a (name), range, air?, cond? (submerged|graveyard|templeSacrifice|spell|transform|...), camo (can target camo), targets (priorities; * = camo-first variant), excl/only (bloon tags filtered), weapons[], cannot/noDamage, canDamageVia (sub|dot when not direct), est
schema.crosspath: src, range, global?, attacks[], subTowers[{ref, via, n?, ...}], abilities[{name, cd, damages?, makesTowers?}], summary
schema.est: ROUGH per-attack rates on ONE target: dps1/dpsMoab/dpsCeramic/dpsBoss = projectiles/s that reach it (spread shots: 1 + (n-1)(1 - arc/30)) x damage of one hit (root + single on-contact/exhaust/expire/pierce children; fragment spreads excluded) + DoT capped at dmg/every per mutation (re-application refreshes, it does not stack). hitsPerSec = projectiles/s x pierce (pierce capped at 1000). No buffs, crits, rehits, instakills (dmg>=1e6), sub-towers or code-driven pets' power scaling. dpsCeramic/dpsBoss omitted when equal to dps1/dpsMoab.
schema.projectile: id, dmg, type, imm (bits it cannot damage), pierce, r (radius), life, speed, move, noCamo, excl/only, bonus[{tags|states|bloons, add, mult, all?} | {bloons, setTo}], bypass (bits ignored), ignoreImm{bits,chance}, setImm, fx[{k: dot|slow|stun|freeze|knockback|blowback|push|maim|strip|cash|tag|...}], rehitEvery, refreshPierceEvery, bounces, chain{splits,range}, subs[{on: contact|exhaust|expire|interval|pierceUsed|damage|pop|galvanized..., n, every?, p}], towers[sub-tower refs], special[behaviours not modelled numerically]
schema.properties: red lead black white zebra purple frozen glass ceramic camo camoHit fortified moab ddt bad boss: a property counts when some damaging node of the attack has dmg+bonus>0 for a bloon with those game tags, its immunity bits allow it, no tag filter stops it, and (camo, ddt) the attack and node can target camo; camoHit = the node can hurt camo it touches even if the attack cannot aim at camo (spikes on the track). summary.strips = camo/regen/fortified/lead removal
schema.subTower: name, baseId, display, firstSeen (file), range, life, lifeRounds, diesWithParent, pet, attacks[], subTowers, abilities
schema.summary: cannot (properties the own non-conditional attacks cannot damage; noDamage if none), camoTargeting, onlyViaSubTowers (properties only sub-towers add), onlyViaConditional, abilityAttacks (abilities that damage or make towers)
schema.tower: name, folder, baseCost, upgrades[path][tier]={id,name,cost,xp}, crosspaths{abc: crosspath}
schema.weapon: w, cd (cooldown s), n (projectiles per shot), em (emission kind), arc (spread deg), burst{n,gap}, alt{every,n,p} (every Nth shot is p instead), triggers/firedBy/pairedWith (secondary fires when its partner fires), crit{dmg,every}, perRound, limit, minCd, mods (rate modifiers), cond, p (projectile), sps (projectiles/s = n*burst/cd, or partner cd)

_meta.units: distances in game units (a Red moves 25/s), times in seconds
